_about: What verify/from-json.js cannot fill mechanically for u-w0t-m8, written by hand and read by it on every run (from-json.js --write gives the same data.js again). gists: a stratagem's one-line summary (the app's own words: its EFFECT shortened, its WHEN/TARGET condition kept, nothing added); def: its When targeted line; both AI-written (Claude, 27 Oct 2026) with the fingerprint (gistOf, defOf) of the text they were written from, so a changed source text fails the gate's fingerprints step. mod: a stratagem's weapon footnote (hand). fixes: GW's Faction Pack words where Wahapedia's transcription differs. units: per unit entry, GW's Faction Pack words where Wahapedia's transcription of an ability differs (texts), and why (the reasons for what the list shows). readings: the readings of the list's rows (only what GW tags (Aura) is an aura, Core Rules 22.01). Each is a judgement verify/helpers.js lists for sign-off.

fixes.why: GW Faction Pack Necrons 1.3, The Phaeron’s Armoury, ENHANCEMENTS: "PRELOCATIONAL OPTIMISER" (BSData: "Prelocational Optimiser"; Wahapedia: "Relocational Optimiser")

Relentless March.why: GW Faction Pack Necrons 1.3, Rules Updates, The Silent King: "Bringer of Unity Ability: Change to ‘Relentless March (Aura): While a friendly NECRONS unit is within 6" of this unit’s Szarekh model, add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.’" (Wahapedia: "(excluding MONSTER units)"; BSData has the pack’s words)

the-silent-king.why: The Silent King: Szarekh and two Triarchal Menhirs, all present from the start (GW’s UNIT COMPOSITION: 1 Szarekh, 2 Triarchal Menhirs); if Szarekh is destroyed the Menhirs are too (Triarchal Menhirs). Keywords as GW’s Faction Pack 1.3 changes them: ALL MODELS VEHICLE, EPIC HERO, TRIARCH; SZAREKH MODEL CHARACTER, THE SILENT KING (kwOnly). Triarch Abilities: GW’s ability (BSData: Voice of the Triarch) selects one of the three abilities of GW’s TRIARCH ABILITIES box at the start of each battle round (Wrathful Presence’s layout, Angron); each is an (Aura) of Szarekh’s, shown with who “Triarch Abilities: pick one”; Relentless March in the pack’s words. Supreme Commander: GW’s box, not in BSData. The Silent King: GW prints it without (Aura) (BSData tags it), Leadership only: no reading. Damaged: Szarekh’s weapons have their Attacks halved and the unit’s attacks -1 to hit: a footnote. Worthy Foes: TRIARCH, so its +1 to wound applies.

ophydian-destroyers.why: Plasmacyte: GW’s wargear option ("For every 3 models in this unit, this unit can have 1 Plasmacyte") this list did not take (the export has no Plasmacyte), so the Plasmacyte ability and its Designer’s Note are left out. Tunnelling Horrors in GW’s Faction Pack 1.3 words (as Wahapedia and BSData).

tesseract-vault.why: Powers of the C’tan: in your Shooting phase, when selected to shoot, it selects up to two different C’tan Powers weapons (one while Damaged); GW prints them as RANGED WEAPONS with [C’TAN POWER] (BSData’s profiles of the type "C'tan Powers", read as weapons): shown as three ranged weapons, the choice is the ability’s, not a pick-one or all-fire group. Tesla sphere: GW’s composition gives 4 tesla spheres (the profile named “Tesla spheres”), New Recruit 4× Tesla sphere: four weapons of A 6. M 14": Empowered Engines (The Phaeron’s Armoury: friendly NECRONS TITANIC FLY units have +6" M), the datasheet’s 8" kept as its own value. Damaged: 1-8 wounds remaining is labelled your Shooting phase (its words: only one C’tan Powers weapon “in your Shooting phase”); a Damaged band otherwise gets no label.

tesseract-vault-2.why: As the other Tesseract Vault (the same datasheet); 505 pts, GW’s price of a 2nd+ unit.

imotekh-the-stormlord.why: Imotekh leads no unit in this list (Leader: IMMORTALS, LYCHGUARD, NECRON WARRIORS): the export attaches him to none, the Immortals included (the Technomancer supports them). NOBLE: Worthy Foes applies.

royal-warden.why: The Royal Warden leads no unit in this list (Leader: IMMORTALS, NECRON WARRIORS): the export attaches it to none, the Immortals included (the Technomancer supports them); Adaptive Strategy ("This model’s unit") is its own. Adaptive Strategy is labelled your Movement, Shooting and Charge phases (verify/derive.js): Fall Back and Advance are moves of your own Movement phase (Core Rules 09.02, 09.07), so its unit cannot have Fallen Back or Advanced in the opponent's Movement phase (Fire Overwatch); as the signed-off Bounding Leaps and Elevated Strider (review result-necrons.json 231348fb544bd6eb).

texts.from: **Example:** A unit of Lokhust Destroyers (which have a Wounds characteristic of 3) activates its Reanimation Protocols. The unit had a Starting Strength of 3, but currently contains 2 models, and one of those models has lost 1 wound. A 3 is rolled to see how many wounds are reanimated. The first of these reanimated wounds restores the wounded Lokhust Destroyer back to 3 wounds. The second of these reanimated wounds returns the destroyed Lokhust Destroyer to the battlefield with 1 wound remaining. The third of these reanimated wounds restores one of the remaining lost wounds to the same Lokhust Destroyer that was just returned. The unit now contains 3 models, two of which have 3 wounds remaining and one of which has 2 wounds remaining.
texts.why: GW Faction Pack Necrons 1.3, Rules Updates, Reanimation Protocols Army Rule, “Change to:” the two paragraphs (“If your Army Faction is NECRONS, at the end of your Command phase, … that unit heals D3 wounds.”), with no Example; Wahapedia still prints the codex’s Example after its errata box.
